text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, February 12, 2018 Posted by admin on February 12th, 2018 
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +156 points. 
Friday the Dow was up +330.44 (+1.38%) at 24,190.90. 
Year-to-date the Dow is down -2.14%. 
There were 27 Dow stocks up Friday. 
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Nike (NKE) +4.80% and American Express (AXP) +3.83%. 
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by United Technologies (UTX) -1.92% and Wal-Mart (WMT) -0.65%. 
American Express (AXP +3.83%) was upgraded to ‘Buy’ from ‘Neutral’ at Nomura Instinet with a 12-month target price of $108. 
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower. 
The national average price of gasoline is down three-tenths of a cent at $2.580 per gallon.
